standing: Fictional delivery example for the carousel. No canonical Lab records, real owner decisions, grants, agent executions or test results are created or asserted.

definition.meaning: A customer export is complete when its returned entry IDs match exactly the IDs selected from the fixed database snapshot by the declared customer and filters.
definition.criterion: OutputIds(E) = RequiredIds(S,A,F). Equivalently, no selected IDs are missing and no returned IDs fall outside the selection.
definition.failure_condition: At least one selected ID is missing, or at least one returned ID is outside the snapshot/account/filter selection.

voices.formal: RequiredIds(S,A,F) = {r.id | r in Records(S), r.account = A, and for every f in F, f(r) is true}. CompleteExport(S,A,F,E) iff OutputIds(E) = RequiredIds(S,A,F).
voices.plain: A customer export is complete when its returned entry IDs match exactly the IDs selected from the fixed database snapshot by the declared customer and filters.
voices.domain: The exported identifiers exactly match the chosen customer and filters in the fixed source snapshot.

definition.challenge_route: Ask the service owner to review evidence or propose a separately governed successor definition.
definition.presentation: A separate fictional Complete customer export v1 for this carousel edition. The older ID-coverage-only definition and canonical Lab records are unchanged.

required_ids_definition.meaning: The identifiers of every record in the fixed source snapshot whose account equals the chosen account and which satisfies every declared filter predicate.
required_ids_definition.formal: RequiredIds(S,A,F) = {r.id | r in Records(S), r.account = A, and for every f in F, f(r) is true}.
required_ids_definition.selection_rule: Select matching records from the full fixed source snapshot, then collect their stable record identifiers. Every filter must match. With no filters, all records for the chosen account qualify.
required_ids_definition.identifier_assumption: Each source record has one stable identifier, unique within this snapshot.
required_ids_definition.reference_boundary: Derive the required set from the source snapshot, not from the candidate export or a partial page of results.

acceptance.illustrative_decision: In the fictional example, the service owner accepts exact Complete customer export v1 as the selection-equivalence criterion.
acceptance.effect: Authority over meaning within the stated scope. No code conformance or agent action permission is inferred.

implementation_assignment.work: Produce candidate implementation I1 for this capability.
implementation_assignment.separate_permission: Edit candidate files and execute the fixed fixture within the declared workspace.

review_assignment.work: Assess exact implementation I1 and its saved output against definition v1.
review_assignment.separate_permission: Inspect selected source/build/output records, compare IDs and prepare review material.

fixture.excluded_source_records: Customer 1’s inactive records and active records belonging to another account fail the declared selection.
fixture.source_kind: database copy saved at one point in time
fixture.source_note: The agreed database copy is the fixed input. No live database access or new agent permissions are implied.

review.method: Compare selected and returned ID sets in both directions: selected minus returned gives missing IDs; returned minus selected gives IDs outside the selection.
review.assessment: All returned IDs satisfy the snapshot/customer/filter selection, but 200 selected IDs are missing. The export therefore fails the complete-export criterion.
review.standing: Illustrative review material, not an admitted Finding or acceptance decision.
review.reference_derivation: Select all Customer 1 records with active status from the fixed source snapshot. Collect their IDs independently of the saved export.

memory.short_term: Private working memory belongs to each ephemeral session.
memory.long_term: Project State preserves the exact definition, snapshot, both code versions, outputs, reviews, Trace 1 and separate acceptance, release-permission, delivery, confirmation and closure records. Later sessions receive selected Context and Ontology Views with their own permissions.
memory.recording: Artifacts and review material follow governed recording routes; agent outputs are not automatically admitted.

editorial_change: This separate fictional definition adds selection membership to required-ID coverage. Value accuracy and duplicates remain outside its scope. It is not a rewrite or admission of a canonical definition.

diagnosis.standing: Illustrative code inspection and controlled replay, not an actual recorded run.
diagnosis.selection: Customer 1 AND status = active, sorted by stable ID
diagnosis.code_condition: Start page at 1 and continue while page < total_pages. Page 50 is never requested.
diagnosis.cause: Off-by-one pagination termination skips the final page of the filtered result.
diagnosis.claim_ceiling: This cause is established only in the authored fictional trace for this exact snapshot and code version. It is not inferred from the row count alone.

successor.repair: Follow pagination until no next page remains.
successor.standing: Illustrative revised version and output; no actual implementation or execution.

successor_review.method: Compare required and returned ID sets in both directions.
successor_review.assessment: Matches Complete customer export v1 for Customer 1 active entries in Snapshot 1.
successor_review.claim_ceiling: ID selection equivalence for this fixture, not general code correctness, value accuracy or automatic acceptance.

successor_assignment.coding: A fresh assignment and scoped permission cover proposed I2 and replay/test work on S1.
successor_assignment.review: A fresh assignment and scoped permission cover Review 2 of exact I2/B2/E2 against definition v1 and S1.
successor_assignment.excluded: Neither job authorizes definition changes, code acceptance, customer release or incident closure.

resolution.standing: Fictional separate decisions and confirmation. No real approval, release or incident closure is asserted.

code_acceptance.subject: I2/B2
code_acceptance.effect: Accept exact Export code v2. Acceptance does not grant release permission.

release_permission.subject: I2/B2/E2
release_permission.scope: Deliver the corrected Customer 1 export for Snapshot 1 under the declared account/filter selection. No blanket deployment permission.

customer_confirmation.report: The corrected file contains the expected selected IDs.

incident_closure.effect: Close this reported Customer 1 omission after corrected delivery and confirmation. Other accounts and wider effects are not assessed.

delivery.effect: Deliver the corrected Exported file 2 to Customer 1 under the scoped permission. Delivery is an event separate from the grant and the customer confirmation.
